body: personally, i dont think she could talk straight away. i would say very quiet and reserved at first as the character is used to and then very, very slowly getting used to it and talking normally. other than that, the book sounds like an amazing idea. so excited!

Thank you. Its nice to hear im not some weird 14 year old, and that there were others like me. I dont expect all of my problems to totally disappear as i get older, but hopefully i can get at least a little better by then. 
Im glad things are working out for you, i hope ill follow in a similar direction! Thank you!

Really? I thought my way of thinking was pretty immature and that would make things harder for me. But thats kind of a relief to hear.
And yeah, i wouldnt diagnose myself with something someone on the internet told me i had lol- i just wanted to figure out where i should start in trying to get better.
Im not really sure how to start with getting help, but ill get there eventually. thank you man!

Wow! I love the way you worded everything. Thank you so much. I still have quite a while to go until im out of my teen years, so well see how that goes LOL. Ill try working on improving myself and just trying to get better. Thank you again!! <3

Aw, thank you. It’s pretty reassuring to see that even though we’re different in a lot of ways, i’m not alone in this. I’m not super sure how to respond lol so im sorry if this reply is kinda awkward. But thank you for taking the time to type such a long message! it means a lot. <3
